propositions: Post-close bug transition emits 'Ambiguous prefix' diagnostics on stderr for unqualified 4-hex commit-subject candidates due to unguarded alias scanning in blame.py without quiet=True or resolution caching.

derive_caused_by performs unbounded O(commits × tickets) alias-file scanning by re-resolving the bug_id on every commit without memoization, causing multi-minute hangs after close has already committed durably.

Bare 4-hex fragments from commit subjects fall through to _scan_alias because they are not full canonical, short, or Jira ids, triggering ~0.26s per unresolvable candidate across 2137+ commits in the branch history.

Four targeted fixes eliminate the hang and noise: pass quiet=True at all scanner sites, hoist bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoize ref→resolution for one derivation, and short-circuit on hex-quad shape before filesystem access when the shape cannot match the target.

Documentation must stop advertising bare 4-digit references as supported forms; only alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, and Jira ids should be recommended, while preserving backward compatibility.

A hex-quad short-circuit guard is sound by control flow in resolve_ticket_id (4-quad returns before alias scan, 2-quad branches to unconditional None return, 1-quad skips alias scan entirely, 3-quad excluded) and does not alter resolution semantics.
